topic.coverageNote: Open update on recent drug-induced lupus cases, naming anti-TNF drugs among systemic cases, chemotherapy among subacute cutaneous cases, procainamide and hydralazine NET formation, and improvement after the drug is stopped. Classic anti-histone teaching is not in the text and is not asked.

mcqs.question: In this review's recent case reports, which drugs were most often reported to introduce systemic drug-induced lupus?
mcqs.explanation: The review says anti-TNF drugs were the most frequently (41.7%) reported to introduce systemic DILE in these cases.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Antitumor necrosis factor (anti-TNF) drugs were the most frequently (41.7%) reported to introduce systemic DILE in these cases.

mcqs.question: Which drug class was most common in the subacute cutaneous lupus cases summarised here?

options.A: Chemotherapeutic drugs (54.5%), with a higher incidence in female patients

mcqs.explanation: The review says chemotherapeutic drugs were the most common class (54.5%) involved in subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus in this set, with a higher incidence in females.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Chemotherapeutic drugs were the most common drug class (54.5%) involved in subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, with an observed higher incidence in female patients.

mcqs.question: What mechanism does the review propose for procainamide and hydralazine?
mcqs.explanation: The review says enhanced NET formation induced by procainamide and hydralazine could be a new mechanism in DILE.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Enhanced neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation induced by procainamide and hydralazine could be a new mechanism contributing to the pathogenesis of DILE.

mcqs.question: What usually happens when the culprit drug is stopped?

options.B: The lupus always becomes permanent and independent of the drug
options.C: The review says stopping the drug has no effect
options.D: Steroids must be lifelong in every case, as a stated rule

mcqs.explanation: The review says discontinuation usually results in improvement of drug-induced manifestations.

sourceRefs.excerpt: discontinuation usually results in improvement of drug-induced manifestations.

mcqs.question: How large was the case set this update summarised?

options.A: 22 articles and 29 case reports, 12 of them systemic (41.4%)

mcqs.explanation: The review summarised 22 articles comprising 29 DILE case reports, including 12 (41.4%) systemic DILE.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Twenty-two articles comprising 29 DILE case reports published within the last 2 years are summarized in this review, including 12 (41.4%) systemic DILE.
